## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and cover the change (a regression test for a bug fix)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (checked by CI)
- [ ] `--help`, man pages and README are updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] An ADR is added in `docs/adr/` if this makes a hard-to-reverse decision
